metadata.description: Claude Code mods by 0xnicholasy, each hosted in its own repo.

plugins.name: agents-office
plugins.description: A pane that shows the session's agents as pixel characters in an office.

plugins.name: todo-list
plugins.description: Plan trees written by Claude through a plan tool, shown in a pane and status line with live activity.

plugins.name: collapse-tools
plugins.description: Collapses every tool-call row in the transcript to one line; click a line to expand it, or run /collapse-tools to toggle all.
